notes.title: Patch 19.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Standard Undersuit is now obtainable from Harkov in Port Cabrakan when starting “A New Arrival”. This is only available if you haven’t gotten the Undersuit before. If you don’t have the Standard Undersuit and have already completed “A New Arrival” then you can talk to Harkov again to get it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screens for Setesh[/p][/*][*][p]A new Account Web has been implemented[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Ashi Oil Field PVP area was larger than intended and has been reduced. [/p][/*][*][p]Non-PVP zone has been added around Setesh Space Station[/p][/*][*][p]Savannah Survey mission in Hunraqan on Setesh can now be accepted even by players who have previously completed Prospective Prospector on Thule[/p][/*][*][p]Sabakuma, Exarosaur and Frescaquda meat now use different visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Names of enhancers have been updated to start with their tier, making it easier to distinguish between enhancers in interfaces with less space for text[/p][list][*][p]Ex: Mining Finder Depth Enhancer 9 is now T9 Mining Finder Depth Enhancer[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]HOF Notification italic fonts have been changed to standard fonts[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a texture issue with rocks around Camp Icarus and Port Atlantis[/p][/*][*][p]Sabakuma, Exarosaur and Frescoquda meat is now stackable[/p][/*][*][p]Sabakuma, Exarosaur and Frescoquda burgers are now stackable[/p][/*][*][p]Robot Scrap from Setesh and Intake Manifolds are now stackable[/p][/*][*][p]The armor platings from the Setesh quests can now be discarded[/p][/*][*][p]Various vehicle cooldowns have been correctly reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with creatures spawning in rocks[/p][/*][*][p]Teleport Chips now accurately indicate their range on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Commandos now progress the Meta Codex[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Possible to get stuck under the hangar platform floor at Cabrakan, but you can still access the platform to leave Setesh (Avoid the hangar platform until you need to leave Setesh)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Patch Size on Steam[/b]: This update will be larger than usual when downloading via Steam. The issue is temporary and will be corrected in an upcoming patch.[/p][/*][/list][p]


[/p][p]Planet ARIS:[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]New skybox texture[/p][/*][*][p]The Hyperion item set bonuses will now work with a mix of different versions. Instead of requiring a full set for activating the buff, a mix of 7 Hyperion pieces of different versions will give the buff of the lowest version equipped. Some examples: [/p][list][*][p]6 Perfected, 1 Improved -> Improved[/p][/*][*][p]1 Perfected, 5 Augmented, 1 Modified - > Modified[/p][/*][*][p]2 Perfected, 5 Augmented -> Augmented[/p][/*][*][p]7 Modified -> Modified[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lowered the amount of Growth Molecules required for that daily mission[/p][/*][*][p]Added exit teleporter to Voltforge Prime boss room[/p][/*][*][p]As an extra safeguard against exploits in the future, and as a workaround for the doors and other objects which won’t sync its state correctly, you are not allowed to log in inside a dungeon with a cooldown. If you crash or disconnect before completing it, you will, however, be able to run it from the start again[/p][/*][*][p]Ironhaven shopping area tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed respawning exploit of Cinderak and Vesuvor. The caves have been enabled again[/p][/*][*][p]Removed incorrect info about Derelict Robot Components having to be refined[/p][/*][*][p]The Hyperion Armor set had a PED cost during development, but before release this was changed to constructed resources to better support the economy. However, the Hyperion Foot Guards (M) accidentally still had this PED cost leftover, which also wasn’t visible in the UI. This has now been removed, and refunds will be issued to everyone who bought them during this time. We apologize for this unfortunate mistake.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a missing part of the roof in the Bovine caves[/p][/*][*][p]Added areas to block players from swimming to the Altar island[/p][/*][*][p]Aurora PP-1, Improved is no longer using BLP[/p][/*][*][p]Hyperium is now orderable[/p][/*][*][p]The AI NPCs should now be less confused and not talk about non-existing places and people[/p][/*][*][p]Creature Control consumables are now blocked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken rock material[/p][/*][*][p]Derelict Drone and Defective Drone are now sized correctly[/p][/*][*][p]You should no longer revive in the wall in dropfort Garriset[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]The sound is still not behaving, and requires in-depth investigation into the engine[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 19.0.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Colonists,[/p][p][/p][p]Today we have an exciting release to share with you all, with the introduction of the [b]New Starter Zone: Setesh.[/b] Setesh replaces the old Thule area that serves as the initial tutorial area for Entropia Universe - you can read in more details about some of the new content and features on Setesh in our previous post here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3642750/view/497205828189683736?l=english"][/dynamiclink]In addition to this, we also have done a pass on the Ashi and Orthos Oil Rigs to increase opportunity and incentivise PvP, you can read more about this here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3642750/view/497205828189683916?l=english"][/dynamiclink]And lastly, we have a number of small quality of life changes that you can read more about in this post:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3642750/view/503961862016074048?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]19.0.0 Release Notes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New beginner experience set on the moon Setesh [/b](replaces Thule)[/p][list][*][p]A lush landscape centered around the bustling frontier city Port Cabrakan[/p][list][*][p]New NPC behavior, enabling schedules, movement and reactions to make locations from now on feel more alive [/p][/*][*][p]New Creatures and Codex entries[/p][list][*][p]Altaik[/p][/*][*][p]Robot Commando[/p][/*][*][p]Setesh variants of existing creatures[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Plenty of new missions introducing the game mechanics and lore, go to Security Chief Harkov to start![/p][list][*][p]New exciting mission rewards for all players (note some items will not be available for people who have played through Thule)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Secrets and side missions to help connect to future content[/p][/*][*][p]Various QoL fixes (details below) to help new players get into the game easier and also alleviate annoyances[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ashi Oil Rig[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ground & flying vehicles allowed in surrounding area (zone on the map); still blocked near the rig[/p][/*][*][p]Oil output increased[/p][/*][*][p]Pets not allowed in the surrounding area[/p][/*][*][p]Creatures cannot be trained into the surrounding area[b]

[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Orthos Oil Rig[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rig reactivated; same rules as Ashi with lower rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Removed robot spawns on the rig area[/p][/*][*][p]Creatures cannot be trained into the rig area[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]The Gauntlet[/b][/p][list][*][p]The instance has been temporarily disabled[/p][/*][*][p]The Vivo S10 reward has been moved to the mission chain in Setesh[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Creatures that are set to be instantly looted when killed are now looted even if the player is dead when the creature dies[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Performance on Setesh, specifically Port Cabrakan and Outpost Bacab is not optimal and we are planning a second pass.[/p][/*][/list][p]


[b]AI System Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Mission System Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Introduced "hand-in" missions, allowing NPCs to request specific items in exchange for rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]New daily mission givers, Trader Joel (Cabrakan) and Trader Joanna (Camp Icarus), have been implemented, offering item-for-reward missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed and resolved an issue where NPCs occasionally experienced "tiredness" when attempting to initiate missions, leading to improved mission initiation reliability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Memory and AI Model Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The NPC memory system has undergone a significant rework, enhancing its efficiency in retaining information over time. This update facilitates the development of more comprehensive and enduring NPC memories regarding user interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Underlying AI models have been upgraded for improved performance and capabilities.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]User Interface (UI) Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Action Bar:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Drag-and-drop no longer requires being in edit mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Action bars can now be individually locked/unlocked to avoid accidental dragging while not in edit mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Message Center:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Message Center window has received a comprehensive overhaul.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed various minor bugs, including incorrect icon rendering, deactivated tutorials displaying pages, and improper display of bid entries (incorrect backgrounds and placement).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]User List:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved a bug preventing the display of offline timers for users.[/p][/*][*][p]The visual presentation of the User List window has been consolidated for a cleaner appearance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Texturizer Tool:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected an issue where items in the Texturizer Tool window did not rotate and zoom accurately in the preview.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chat System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chat colors have been restored to their pre-UI update palette.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quest Tracker:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A soft background has been added behind the text in the Quest Tracker to enhance readability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Options Menu:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new "MISC" option, previously exclusive to the client launcher settings, is now directly accessible within the in-game Options menu, this for example includes language and connection settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropdown menus within the Options with a significant number of entries now provide increased visual space to facilitate scrolling.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Known Issues:[/p][list][*][p][b]Friend Requests[/b] is not working properly in the Message Center - this will be patched [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Vehicle Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Place and Enter action:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new vehicle action that spawns the vehicle at the player’s position and automatically enters the vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]Accessed through the inventory or by using a vehicle in the hot bar.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Recall Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The recall action now returns the vehicle to inventory while on the same planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new recall action that forces all vehicles to planet storage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Automatic recall:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new option for automatically recalling vehicles to the inventory when they are far away.[/p][/*][*][p]The distance is configurable by the player.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Automatic re-equip:[/b][/p][list][*][p]If a tool was equipped while entering a vehicle it will be re-equipped upon exiting the vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]This is disabled in PvP[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Map:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nearby owned vehicles now appear as a floating marker[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: DEV BLOG: Upcoming Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings Colonists,  [/b][/p][p]In the upcoming Onboarding Update, we will also have a number of small quality of life changes coming with the update that we want to make you aware of. These changes mostly impact Vehicles and UI, and some improvements for those using the Steam Version of Entropia.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]More Settings for the Steam Client[/b][/h3][p]Currently there are a number of options in our Standalone Client Loader that are not available to users using the Steam Version of the game, including Language Selection and Connection Settings. 

We are pleased to say that these settings will now be found ingame in the options menu, under the new Misc category. This will now mean that the Steam Version of the game will be principally identical to the Standalone, for those that may wish to make the switch to Steam.[b]

[/b][/p][h3][b]User Interface (UI) Updates[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Action Bar:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Drag-and-drop no longer requires being in edit mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Action bars can now be individually locked/unlocked to avoid accidental dragging while not in edit mode.[/p][/*][/list][p]We found that for new players (and existing) that needing to enter and exit edit mode every time you wish to adjust something on your hotbar was tedious and annoying, so now you will be able to freely move an item on, off and around the hotbar freely - with a locking feature to prevent any misclicks during normal play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/c6f30d2731c3c9f96a6db8ea8496a1d7c74b9511.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Locking Icon visible to the right of the hotbar - becomes hidden when not hovered over[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Message Center:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Message Center window has received a visual overhaul.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed various minor bugs, including incorrect icon rendering, deactivated tutorials displaying pages, and improper display of bid entries (incorrect backgrounds and placement).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]User List:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved a bug preventing the display of offline timers for users.[/p][/*][*][p]The visual presentation of the User List window has been consolidated for a cleaner appearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Texturizer Tool:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected an issue where items in the Texturizer Tool window did not rotate and zoom accurately in the preview.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Chat System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chat colors have been restored to their pre-UI update palette.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/ab4a021ed3c8797ebb224e73eea89dfe4d4f81ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Quest Tracker:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A soft background has been added behind the text in the Quest Tracker to enhance readability.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/42d6a35717e9bf5aa0a8294ca90e803d68194362.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Options Menu:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dropdown menus within the Options with a significant number of entries now provide increased visual space to facilitate scrolling.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Vehicle Updates[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Place and Enter action:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new vehicle action that spawns the vehicle at the player’s position and automatically enters the vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]Accessed through the inventory or by using a vehicle in the hot bar.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/8d2655abce8da633a6cb77c376b4ea4cc48cd8a8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Recall Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The recall action now returns the vehicle to inventory while on the same planet.[/p][/*][*][p]A new recall action that forces all vehicles to planet storage.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/300597f1430161e06e070281e109a804e839e162.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Automatic recall:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new option for automatically recalling vehicles to the inventory when they are far away.[/p][/*][*][p]The distance is configurable by the player.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Automatic re-equip:[/b][/p][list][*][p]If a tool was equipped while entering a notes.title: Breaking the Siege of Cape Corinth
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/e79ab6e7c480e5bed15b33b34429dcbf154c9b9f.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Colonists,[/p][p][/p][p]CDF Officials have identified vast robot forces moving from Hadesheim towards Cape Corinth, and intercepted transmissions suggest that a full siege is to be expected.
[/p][h3]Defending the Front Lines[/h3][p]The besieging forces, made up of Drone Coordinators and led by Warlock Commanders is expected to arrive at approximately [b]10:00 UTC on September 17th.[/b] Cape Corinth Authorities have announced that any colonist that is able to obtain a [b]Rare Robot Secret Transmitter[/b] from the invading robots will be rewarded with a [b]beach-front house estate[/b] in the Cape Corinth Area. A total of 10 estates will be available to claim, and any colonist who has obtained a transmitter have the estate automatically traded to them.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Supplies for the Fight[/h3][p]While colonists of all skill levels will be required at the front lines, there is also an urgent need for supplies and materials at Cape Corinth in order to keep defences repaired, supply lines running and positions reinforced. As such, there will be significant buy orders for the following items on the auction to support the defence effort: [/p][list][*][p]Welding Wire[/p][/*][*][p]Simple 3 Plastic Ruds[/p][/*][*][p]Simple 3 Plastic Springs[/p][/*][*][p]Simple 3 Conductors[/p][/*][*][p]Composite Planks
[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to offering competitive prices on these items, Cape Corinth Authorities will be offering a [b]Marketplace Shop Estate [/b]in Cape Corinth to the colonist who provides the most in TT value to the buy orders, with one estate on offer for each different item.
[/p][h3]Recovering the Data Recorders[/h3][p]The authorities have also placed a bounty on [b]Flight Data Recorders [/b]that can be found in the area of the invasion - any colonist who discovers one will receive a Pitbull Trailblazer (L) as a reward. A total of 10 recorders have been identified for possible discovery.

The recorders can be found on the ground, approximately in the area marked below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/23a1e67e70213f47f669ddc0dfe2f738897305fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If all [b]Flight Data Recorders[/b] can be found, additional loot may be found on the invading robot forces.[/p][p][/p][h3]CDF Commander Martin[/h3][p]The CDF Commander in charge of the defence of Cape Corinth, aside from very important administrative activities, may from time to time be found around the area and front lines. He deeply values the bravery, effort and [i]sweat[/i] of fighting colonists, and as such, he may bestow powerful effects to you should you trade him 1000 Vibrant Sweat. 

These effects will only last until you die, or log off.

[/p][h3]Event End[/h3][p]The event will come to a close once all [b]Rare Robot Secret Transmitters [/b]have been looted.

[/p][h3]FAQ[/h3][p]Q: Will the Rare Robot Secret Transmitters give a rare item HoF?
A: Yes

Q: Do we need to make support cases to receive the estates?
A: No, they will be traded automatically to you at the event end

Q: How difficult will the robots be to kill?
A: The Coordinators range from level 13 to 29, whilst the Warlocks will be boss levels.[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Changes: Ashi and Orthos Oil Rig
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/4050c521674ae5c38db96d5c71a6f01522103696.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Colonists,

Today we would like to share with you some minor changes that will happen in an upcoming release. While these changes are small, we wanted to provide you with information ahead of time.
[/p][p]However, we want to be very clear - these changes are a [b]trial[/b] that we will review at a later point.[/p][p][/p][h2]Oil Rigs[/h2][p]Ashi Oil Rig is a great area for players to get involved early with PvP, and of course the chance to grab some oil for themselves.  One of the issues facing this area is the mix between PvE and PvP - most notably when players often drag creatures into the area to “grief” or otherwise disrupt the area. This is not only frustrating for players, but also disincentivises PvP due to high-tier limited PvP gear taking decay from mob trains. We want Ashi Oil Rig to be more of a pure PvP arena, and open up more options so we are making some changes as follows: [/p][olist][*][p]Turrets around the oil rig area to prevent creatures from being dragged in, and keep it PvP focused[/p][/*][*][p]Ground and Flying vehicles will be permitted in the PvP Zone[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles will not be allowed in the immediate oil spawning area to prevent camping inside wrecks[/p][/*][*][p]Pets will not be allowed in the PvP Zones (Orthos + Ashi)[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of oil per drop at the rig will be [b]tripled [/b](for Ashi) to make PvP more rewarding there[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]In conjunction with this, we will also be [b]reopening Orthos Oil Rig[/b] (located near Camp Icarus) to incentivize more activity in that area, and offer something interesting for new players in the game to experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We will be looking at other PvP things, including Land Grab in the future.[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update: New Onboarding Experience
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/8dfe1bda6907f07c90e5906135f799c6ef988f89.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Colonists,
[/p][p]Today we want to share with you an update talking about the upcoming changes to the onboarding experience - namely the area currently known as Thule.

[i]All shown images are in-development areas that are subject to change and not finalised.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h2]A New Zone - Welcome to Setesh[/h2][p]Our current starting zone, Thule, physically makes up a very small area that funnels new players through a very linear and closed environment. We want players to feel like they experience the large open world that Entropia really is.[/p][p][/p][p]To that end, let us introduce the new starting zone: Setesh. This new area is nearly an entire server area, with different biomes, dynamic events, hunting arenas - and our new starting city hub of Port Cabrakan.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/30f344403c02a16319e6fa01a2c638404745ea86.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/08632a0fffd64c919d72512038575ce4ece58019.png"][/img][/p][p]Our core mission chain in Setesh will take new players through the various biomes, locations and points of interest as part of the experience - with smaller side missions and hunting areas for those who wish to spend more time in the area.[/p][p][/p][p]When players first touch down, they will be entering Port Cabrakan - our hub for Setesh. Cabrakan has been created to feel fresh, alive and full of character which sets a new standard for how areas in the rest of the game can look in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]Existing players will also be able to travel to Setesh anytime without the previous requirements that Thule had.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/67a7d16a4c91a38034904998601302e06112929d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/988a2ad9c2ba5b9a1f797c68cff51d7aac99787f.png"][/img][/p][h2]Enhanced Systems[/h2][p]As part of this release, we have also developed a number of improvements and new capabilities that we will be showcasing in Setesh, with the aim to roll these capabilities out to other areas in the game at a later point.[/p][p][/p][h3]Living NPCs[/h3][p]One thing that has been lacking from Entropia Universe are living, [i]moving[/i] NPCs. With this release we will for the first time have NPCs that traverse the world on their own just like players. They have schedules, behaviours and lives to live. Not only does this make the world feel more alive, but also opens up new possibilities in the future for new kinds of events, missions and interactions.
[/p][h3]Dynamic Hand-in Missions[/h3][p]We have also been working hard on our Dynamic Mission System - and with this upcoming release will feature hand-in quests for the first time. This will give players the opportunity to exchange loot from their hunting activities in return for a chance at something more valuable. It is even possible now to chain multiple dynamic hand-in missions together.
[/p][h3]A World in Motion[/h3][p]In addition to our moving NPCs, we have also made a number of other graphical improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Animated signs and billboards[/p][/*][*][p]Improved animated objects, such as flags blowing in the wind and functioning elevators [/p][/*][*][p]Rendered interiors - peer into buildings to see inside

[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Everything[/h2][p]This new zone isn’t just a copy and paste of the old Thule items and missions, we’ve fundamentally redesigned the experience from the ground up. Some of the many changes that will be included are listed below:[/p][list][*][p]Brand new weapons and weapon varieties[/p][list][*][p]New players get their hands on Pistols, Rifles and Swords - gaining more powerful versions as they go through the experience[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Brand new starter vehicle: The Wasp[/p][/*][*][p]Starter Armor Set[/p][/*][*][p]“Micro-Economy” allowing new players to play longer for less[/p][/*][*][p]New Creatures and Maturities[/p][/*][*][p]New Dynamic Events for new players to work together on[/p][/*][*][p]New “Universe Chat” and the ability to opt-out of Rookie and Universe Chat[/p][/*][*][p]Many Quality of Life changes[/p][/*][*][p]New mission chain and side missions[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorials  [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/ee62db427ccd4c4a8d66f61afea2941581dfbd4d.png"][/img][i]New Drone Model[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Putting it all together[/h2][p]This upcoming release and follow-up releases go hand in hand with our other efforts to make starting in Entropia Universe easier and better than ever. Earlier this summer we released the first phase of our new Starter Packs, which was a tremendous success in making Entropia more affordable and rewarding for new players.[/p][p][/p][p]This upcoming release will build on that, further improving retention.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we have recently and will continue to run frequent and more varied events - incorporating all professions into fun, engaging and interesting events that we hope will not only engage our existing players and give them something to look forward to, but also capture the imagination and excitement of new players too. We don't want events to just be Mayhem - we want something fun to look forward to all the time.
[/p][p]We also have more planned additions to the web shop coming soon, including profession focused Starter Kits, and other items too.[/p][p][/p][h2]Continuous Improvement[/h2][p]After the initial planned release, we plan to continue fleshing out, patching and improving the experience on Setesh based on various analytics and feedback gathered from players to refine and perfect this new experience. We also plan to release a new and improved version of the character creator and revise the existing newcomer content on Calypso.
[/p][p]As Setesh is also a much larger zone than Thule - it offers the perfect opportunity to flesh out the content available in the area with more missions and activities in future releases.
[/p][p]We will remain committed post-release to build on the work we have done so far.[/p]

notes.title: Crafting Mania: Megingjord Tank

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/054483e214ca0fa3226c77f163c0829513589208.png"][/img][/p][h2]Greetings Colonists,[/h2][p][/p][p]The CDF is calling all crafters to find Combobulator blueprints, each of which can be exchanged for one click of a [b]Megingjord Mk. 1 (C,L) Blueprint (L) [/b]and [b]Megingjord Turret Mk. 1 (C,L) Blueprint (L).[/b]

[/p][p]The special level 3 Combobulator Blueprints can be found when crafting in all crafting disciplines, so it doesn’t matter if you are a tailor or tools crafter, or specialized in any of the other crafting disciplines - the chance to loot these special blueprints while crafting is the same.
 [/p][h3]Event Dates[/h3][p]The event will start 08/22/2025 at 10:00am UTC. The event will end 08/31/2025 at 10:00am UTC.

You can submit support cases here: [url="https://account.entropiauniverse.com/support-faq/contact/"]https://account.entropiauniverse.com/support-faq/contact/[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: New Entropians - Start Here!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691366/426f85f2171734e7a9c198bc65ea689075ad9e8e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello! We are very much looking forward to welcoming new Entropians to our community very soon - and as such we wanted to provide a few good pointers for how best to get involved in Entropia Universe.
[/p][p][/p][h2]Join the Community[/h2][p]We have a large and helpful community of colonists already playing the game who can help you learn the ropes! Here are some of the ways you can find them:

[url="https://www.reddit.com/r/entropiauniverse/" style="button"]Reddit[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.planetcalypsoforum.com/forum/index.php" style="button"]Game Forums[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/tK6WvDR6N4" style="button"]Community Discord[/url][/p][p]And of course, this [b]Steam Community Hub![/b]

You will also find that [b]Entropia has many in game chat channels you can join[/b] centered around certain topics. You can join a channel ingame by typing [i]/join #channelname[/i] into the chat window!

[b]#waveevents[/b] - For finding group content with others
[b]#calypso[/b] - For chatting with others on the main planet
[b]#calytrade[/b] - For buying and selling
[b]#crt[/b] - Calypso Rescue Team (if you get lost and stuck!)[/p][h2]
Find a Mentor[/h2][p]Entropia Features a Mentoring System, where more experienced players can help new players learn the game, and if completed both you and your mentor get rewards that will help you progress in the game!
[/p][p][b]How to Find a Mentor?[/b]
There are a few ways you can find a mentor:[/p][olist][*][p]Open the Action Library ('n') and search for Mentor Register. Here you can find mentors to apply to[/p][/*][*][p]Find someone ingame and ask them to be your mentor! You may find a friend a long the way and may wish take them as your mentor. They can send you a request, or you can make it yourself by interacting with their avatar.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[b]Tips for selecting a Mentor
[/b][/p][olist][*][p]You may wish to pick someone who has a good record on the Mentor Register[/p][/*][*][p]Do not accept random mentorship requests from random people![/p][/*][*][p]Build up some rapport with another player before considering having them as your mentor
[/p][/*][/olist][h2]Watch Entropia Content on Twitch & YouTube![/h2][p]Another way to learn about the game is to watch! Interacting with streamers is a great way to go as they can answer your questions live! There are also many great guides on [b]YouTube[/b]!

[url="https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/entropia-universe" style="button"]Entropia on Twitch[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]If you encounter issues...[/h2][p]If you can't resolve your issue by asking another player - you can create a support case on our Account Website and support will assist you with your issue. There are also MindArk representatives on the [b]Subreddit, Community Discord [/b]and [b]Game Forums.[/b]
[/p]
